confidence_notes: I based the restaurant meal and coffee anchors on one web search of aggregated cost-of-living sites (traveltables, citycost, Numbeo, expatistan). Those sites agree on rough ranges but give different exact figures, and some of their data is old (2023 to 2025). I adjusted upward for Egyptian inflation through July 2026. Beer is less certain because Numbeo had no draft beer price for Aswan, so I used Egypt-wide figures of about $1.60–$1.80 and adjusted for tourist restaurants that hold alcohol licences. Alcohol is sold only in a limited number of licensed venues in Aswan, mostly hotels and tourist places. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I estimated them as multiples of the beer price, reflecting how expensive imported spirits and wine are in Egypt. All accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates, not taken from listings. Aswan has few registered hostels, and summer (July) is low season with lower rates, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I used Luxor as the main comparison because it is a similar Upper Egypt tourist city on the Nile. I checked the figures against Egypt-wide cost-of-living averages and set Aswan slightly below Cairo for food.
